Thanks Karthik — taking point to track owners into the QBR pack. I pulled the spreadsheet and created a short owner view (see Drive link). A couple clarifications and asks from me:

- Marcus: can you confirm whether the model-quant exception is a code change or a serving config? If code, we need a patch + canary; if config, we can scope a rollback plan. Blocker = infra for canary or model work.
- Lauren: SLO carve — list the customer-facing impact (one bullet) and whether we need a pricing note for the execs.
- Olga: for security evidence, please confirm which classifier of evidence is missing (SOC2 evidence vs retention policy) and whether legal needs to be looped in.
- Vivek: if infra agrees to the canary window, please provide a ticket number + tentative slot.

I've added tentative due dates next Wed (2027-04-21) for owner updates so we can bake the QBR narrative on Thu. If anyone needs a later slot, call it out with a reason.

Marissa
